starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.player: How would I go about protecting this nautical fellow from the curse of the culinaromancer then?

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.text: Hmmm... Wait a moment, my fortune-teller-sense is tingling...

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.text: Ah yes. To immunise him from the culinaromancer's attack, you will need to feed him fishcakes.

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.player: Fishcakes? What, like chocolate cake with fish instead of chocolate?

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.text: No... Like small bread crumbed fishy delicacies.

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.player: Um... So how would I make those then?

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.text: I don't know. I am a fortune-teller, not a cook.

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.text: I don't suppose it occurred to you to ask the actual cook in the room right next door to us?

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete.player: Ooooh yeah... I'll be right back!

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.player: How would I go about protecting this nautical fellow from the curse of the culinaromancer then?

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.text: Err... have you forgotten about the fishcakes already?

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.player: I might have, I might not have.
This time-travelling stuff just has me a little worn out ok?

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.text: To immunise him from the culinaromancer's attack, you will need to feed him fishcakes.

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.player: Fishcakes? What, like chocolate cake with fish instead of chocolate?

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.text: No... Like small bread crumbed fishy delicacies.

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.player: Um... So how would I make those then?

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.text: I don't know. I am a fortune-teller, not a cook.

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.text: I don't suppose it occurred to you to ask the actual cook in the room right next door to us?

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.player: Ooooh yeah... I'll be right back!

starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.speaker: Aris
starting-out-inspecting-pirate-pete-agai.text: And try not to forget this time!

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.player: Can we talk about what happened in the dining room?

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: Wow! You were incredible! The way you defeated the Culinaromancer, you made it seem so easy!

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: With the foods, and that big portal thingy, and everything!

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: I'm just glad you were around, who knows WHAT could have happened if you weren't able to help us!

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.player: I'm sorry, I don't have any clue what you...
Oh. Oh, right. This must be part of that whole time-bubble thing that Aris told me about.
So the cook outside of the bubble remembers me having already saved the council members even though I haven't actually gone and done it yet...
Gah! This time travel stuff makes my head hurt!
So... I don't suppose you can remember exactly how I defeated him can you?

starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
starting-out-talking-to-the-cook.text: Of course! Which bit can't you remember doing?

steps.player: I can't quite remember how I managed to save that pirate...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: The pirate? Yes, you used fishcakes didn't you?

steps.player: I did? Er... I mean I did.
Out of interest, could you just help me quickly with that?
Can you tell me how to make fishcakes?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Fishcakes? As in with fish eggs and fish milk?

steps.player: Don't be silly, that would never work.
Can you check to see if there is a recipe for them?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Of course.
The Chef checks one of his cookbooks.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Found it!

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Apparently you need Ground Cod, Ground Kelp, Ground Giant Crab Meat and Breadcrumbs.

options.text: Where do I get Ground Cod?

steps.player: Where do I get Ground Cod?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Well, if you use a pestle and mortar on a raw cod that will grind it up nicely.

options.text: Where do I get Ground Kelp?

steps.player: Where do I get Ground kelp?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: There are apparently some kelp patches off the coast near Rimmington. Murphy knows more about that.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: As for the grinding part, all you have to do is use a pestle and mortar on it, that ought to get it sorted.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Murphy also used to bring in Giant Crabs occasionally. He hasn't had any of them in for a while though.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: You had best go and have a word with him to see if he can tell you what happened.

options.text: Where do I get Ground Giant Crab Meat?

steps.player: Where do I get Ground Giant Crab meat?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Well, Murphy used to bring in Giant Crabs occasionally. He hasn't had any of them in for a while though.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: You had best go and have a word with him to see if he can tell you what happened.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Oh, and  there are apparently some kelp patches off the coast near Rimmington. Murphy knows about that too.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: As for the grinding part, all you have to do is use a pestle and mortar on it, that ought to get it sorted.

steps.player: Where do I get Breadcrumbs?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: That's easy, all you do is use a knife to slice the bread up into tiny, tiny chunks.

options.text: What do I do with all of it?

steps.player: What did I do with all of it?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: I'm not entirely sure. What am I, an encyclopedia?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: I'll have a look through my cookbook while I wait for the ingredients.

steps.player: Ok, I'll go out and get all of the stuff and bring it to you.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Ok.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Is there anything else you need to know?

options.condition: If the player has asked at least one question

steps.player: Thanks!

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: No problem!

steps.player: Murphy, what can you tell me about giant crabs?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Giant Crabs? Why, I used to haul up a few of those whenever I set my nets around Rimmington.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Why the interest?

steps.player: I need to get some Giant Crab Meat and Kelp. Can you tell me where I can get some?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well, the only thing I can think to do is to go down there and look to see if there are any left.

steps.player: Go down there? What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: As in under the water!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Tell me, can you get your hands on a fishbowl?

steps.player: I'm sure I will be able to if I put my mind to it, why do you ask?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well, I know how to rig up a handy set of breathing gear that can allow you to keep air inside the fishbowl.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: You just put the barrel of air on your back, with the fishbowl over your head, and then dive over the side.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: It should hold enough air to keep you alive for quite some time.

steps.player: That sounds pretty dangerous...

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Not at all. I'll even weigh anchor with the chain somewhere easy to reach so you can climb out easily enough if you run into trouble.

steps.player: I'm still not happy about this...

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well, I can't think of any other way to check. If you come up with a better plan then feel free to tell me.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: In the meantime I'll wait, and if you want me to take you diving I'll be ready.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: By the way, why are you so interested in crabs all of a sudden?

steps.player: I can't tell you I'm afraid. The very fabric of space and time could collapse!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well, I guess some people will do anything for a bit of fresh seafood.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Ahoy there! Up for a bit of a swim?
If the player doesn't have a fishbowl:

steps.player: Not just yet.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well, whenever you want me to get you some diving gear, just come and see me with a fishbowl.
If the player has a fishbowl:

steps.player: I certainly am.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Great! I'll sort that fishbowl out for you.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: There you go.

steps.player: Are you sure this is safe?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Sure! It's as sound as my ship!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Want me to take you out now?

steps.player: Yes, Let's go diving.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well I can't take you out until you are properly geared up.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: We lost three diving parties that way!

steps.player: Ok, well I'll just put my diving helmet and diving backpack on.

steps.text: If the player has lost their diving helmet:

steps.player: Murphy, can I get another diving helmet?

steps.text: If the player has a full inventory:

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well sure, just as soon as you have some spare space for it.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Sure, here you go. Try not to lose this one, I'm not a very good glassblower.

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well, the bowls I make tend to shatter under pressure into razor-sharp shards of lethal, face shredding shrapnel.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Don't let it bother you, I think I know what I'm doing wrong now.
If the player has lost their diving apparatus:

steps.player: Hello Murphy. Do you have a spare diving backpack?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Sure, I have plenty after the...little incident.

steps.player: What 'little incident'?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Nothing to worry yourself about.
If the player has a full inventory:

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well, I have plenty of them under the tap, getting sluiced off. When you have space for one come and see me.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Here, have this one. Only dropped once!

steps.player: Is that blood?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: No, no.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well, yes.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: But seriously, what are the chances of getting a jellyfish jammed in there again?
If the player has all their equipment:

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Ahoy there! All set for a dive?

steps.player: Yes, Let's go diving.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have the diving equipment on:

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well I can't take you out until you are properly geared up.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: We lost three diving parties that way!

steps.player: Ok, well I'll just put my diving helmet and diving backpack on.

steps.text: If the player weighs more than 27kg:

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well that's the sort of spirit I like to see. However you are far too heavy to go diving right now.

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well, I can't take you diving if you are carrying more than 27kg worth of equipment.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: We arrived at that number through trial and error, and the errors were not pretty let me assure you.

steps.player: So what can I do?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Well, if you pop over to a bank and leave all your heavy equipment behind then I'll take you out.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: See you then!
If the player has any pet other than a cat following them:

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: I'm not taking you out for a dive with that pet following you. It'll get wet.
If the player has a cat following them:

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: You want that cat of yours to drown or something?

steps.player: You mean you can't make them an adorable set of tiny diving gear?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: No. Just...no.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: I'm not taking you out for a dive with that cat following you.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: I'm not a cat person, and it'd have to stay on the ship while you were down.
If the player has a cat in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: You know, I can see your cat right there.

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: I'm looking right at it. See, it's just there in your bag!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: I'm not taking you out with that cat. I'm not some sort of cat-sitter, so go and put it somewhere safe, then come back.

steps.player: O'kay...
I still think I should get some cat-sized diving gear...

steps.text: If the player is properly equipped:

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Ok, let's be off then.
(Cutscene plays of Murphy taking the player out on a boat.)

steps.player: Ok, see you soon Murphy!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.text: Good luck, I'll weigh anchor. Climb up the chain to get aboard.

underwater-trying-to-enter-the-underwate.text: You have no idea what is in there, best leave it for the time being.

underwater-talking-to-a-mogre-guard.speaker: Mogre Guard
underwater-talking-to-a-mogre-guard.text: Silly fishy! You lookin' like likkle Mogre wid your likkle arms an' wid your likkle legs!

underwater-talking-to-a-mogre-guard.speaker: Mogre Guard
underwater-talking-to-a-mogre-guard.text: Swim along silly round head fishy!

underwater-talking-to-a-mogre-guard.speaker: Mogre Guard
underwater-talking-to-a-mogre-guard.text: Dont let dem big skippies eat you!

underwater-trying-to-open-the-pen-door-e.speaker: Mogre Guard
underwater-trying-to-open-the-pen-door-e.text: Hey! Nung says no fishies in da big crunchy claws!

underwater-trying-to-open-the-pen-door-e.speaker: Mogre Guard
underwater-trying-to-open-the-pen-door-e.text: You want crunchies, you talk to him, an' hope he not hungry!

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Hey, silly fishy wit da round head!

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Ya! What kinda fishy you's tinkin you are?

underwater-talking-to-nung.player: I'm not any kind of fishy, err, fish.

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Well what you doin' here if you's no a fishy?

underwater-talking-to-nung.player: Well I'm trying to get some Giant Crab meat.

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Dis fishy is a funny fishy!

underwater-talking-to-nung.player: You see those big crabs? I want one of those.

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: You's here to stealin' my big crunchy claws?

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Nung should smash your stoopid round head!

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Always the big nettings was taking my big crunchy claws, I put them in the cages, and now you's come to get them.

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Swim away little fishy or I eat you till you's dead!

underwater-talking-to-nung.player: Wait, could I buy some of the crab meat?

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Silly round head fishy want to swaps big crunchy claws?

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Naaah...you no real deal. I bet you no do Nung big favour.

underwater-talking-to-nung.player: Seriously, I need to get that meat. I'll do your big favour if you want.

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Hah! Silly round head fishy! If you get Nung 5 big skippy skins, den maybe Nung thinking you ok.

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: Ya, da big skippies live over dere.
(Cutscene highlighting the Underwater Cavern Entrance plays.)

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: You need lotsa big big stones to get down dere. Den you kill da big skippies and bring da skins to Nung.

underwater-talking-to-nung.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung.text: You do dis, den maybe Nung let you swaps da big crunchy claws.

underwater-talking-to-nung-again.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung-again.text: Hey fishy! You gots da skippy skins?

underwater-talking-to-nung-again.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung-again.text: Den no crunchy claws for you!

underwater-picking-up-rocks.text: If the player is holding less than 5 rocks:

steps.text: You pick up a rock and put it in your pocket.

underwater-picking-up-rocks.text: If the player picks up a 6th rock:

steps.text: You have enough rocks to stand on the sea bed if you need to.

underwater-entering-the-underwater-caver.text: If the player hasn't collected 5 rocks:

steps.text: You need to collect 5 rocks to get into the pen.

underwater-entering-the-underwater-caver.text: If the player has enough rocks:

steps.text: You enter the cave...

underwater-exit-the-underwater-cavern-en.text: You kick off the sea bed and begin swimming again.

underwater-bringing-nung-the-mudskipper-.player: Nung, I have your giant Mudskipper Skins.

underwater-bringing-nung-the-mudskipper-.speaker: Nung
underwater-bringing-nung-the-mudskipper-.text: What you say? Has da silly round headed fishy got da big skippy skins?

underwater-bringing-nung-the-mudskipper-.player: Yes, I have the big skippy skins.

underwater-bringing-nung-the-mudskipper-.speaker: Nung
underwater-bringing-nung-the-mudskipper-.text: Silly round head fishy done good!  Gimme!
If the player has given Nung fewer than 5 hides:

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: Ya, dis fishy is a good fishy, but it no count good like Nung! Nung say dere are dis many hides left for da fishy to get.
Nung holds up [number] of his fingers.

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: Go get me da hides little fishy!

underwater-bringing-nung-the-mudskipper-.text: If the player has given Nung 5 hides:

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: Ya, da round head fishy does a good big favour for Nung.

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: I am thinkin you's ok enough to swaps the giant crunchy claws now.

steps.player: Great! How much do you want for them?

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: You's gotta get me somefing to make dese hides to a cloak and flippers and hat, den I lets you have all the big crunchy claws you can get.

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: But it not be easy

steps.player: Well I'll do it. What do I need? An item of ancient power? Something from the deepest, darkest dungeon in the world?
What sort of monsters will I need to fight? I'd best grab myself some potions too.
Will there be traps? Should I bring cakes?

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: Ya, it real dangerous for a fishy.

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: You's gotta go up to da topsies, and your gotta get a needly-thing and some wirey stuff.

steps.player: A needle.

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: Ya.

steps.player: And bronze wire.

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: Ya. Tree wirey stuffs.

steps.player: So, all I have to do is bring you three rolls of bronze wire and a needle, and I can have all the Giant Crabs I can kill?

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: Ya, but be a sneaky round head fishy. Da topsies has not water for a little fishy like you to breathing.

steps.speaker: Nung
steps.text: It REAL dangerous.

steps.player: Yeah, sounds it.

underwater-talking-to-nung-without-the-w.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung-without-the-w.text: Has da fish brung Nung the wiry stuff and the needly thing?

underwater-talking-to-nung-without-the-w.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung-without-the-w.text: Nung not supprised, the upsies is real scaredy for da little fishies like you.

underwater-talking-to-nung-with-the-wire.player: Nung, I have the needle and wire.

underwater-talking-to-nung-with-the-wire.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung-with-the-wire.text: Nung thinks this is a useful fishy he finds. Gimme!

underwater-talking-to-nung-with-the-wire.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung-with-the-wire.text: Nung have all da wiry stuff and needly things he needs to make da biggestest skippy skin hat ever!

underwater-talking-to-nung-with-the-wire.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung-with-the-wire.text: You's a good little fishy, you eat as many big crunchy claws as you want.

underwater-talking-to-nung-with-the-wire.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung-with-the-wire.text: Maybe you get big and strong like Nung!

underwater-talking-to-nung-again-2.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung-again-2.text: Hey fishy. If you's a good fishy I might sell yous bitses of skippy skin clothes.

underwater-talking-to-nung-again-2.speaker: Nung
underwater-talking-to-nung-again-2.text: But Nung needs time to makes them first.

underwater-trying-to-enter-the-crab-pen.player: I just spoke to Nung, he said it was ok.

underwater-trying-to-enter-the-crab-pen.speaker: Mogre Guard
underwater-trying-to-enter-the-crab-pen.text: Well...if Nung say it ok, den go ahead.
If the player does not have enough rocks:

steps.text: You try to enter the pen, but the current is too strong.
You need to collect 5 rocks to get into the pen.

underwater-trying-to-enter-the-crab-pen.text: With the rocks in your pocket you can quite easily land on the sea bed.
It is a little slippery, but you should be able to fight normally.

underwater-exiting-the-crab-pen.text: You kick off from the sea bed and begin swimming again.

underwater-climbing-the-anchor.text: If the player is holding any rocks:

steps.text: You have to drop all of your rocks to surface.

underwater-climbing-the-anchor.speaker: Murphy
underwater-climbing-the-anchor.text: Great, I'll take us back in.

finishing-up-using-raw-cod-on-a-pestle-a.text: You grind the Cod into a paste.

finishing-up-using-crab-meat-on-a-pestle.text: You grind the Giant Crab meat into a paste.

finishing-up-using-a-knife-on-bread.text: You slice the bread into breadcrumbs.

finishing-up-using-kelp-on-a-pestle-and-.text: You grind the Kelp into flakes.

finishing-up-trying-to-combine-the-ingre.text: You do not yet know how to make fishcakes.

finishing-up-talking-to-the-cook.player: Can we talk about what happened in the dining room?

finishing-up-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
finishing-up-talking-to-the-cook.text: Wow! You were incredible! The way you defeated the Culinaromancer, you made it seem so easy!

finishing-up-talking-to-the-cook.player: So... I don't suppose you can remember exactly how I defeated him can you?

finishing-up-talking-to-the-cook.speaker: Cook
finishing-up-talking-to-the-cook.text: Of course! Which bit can't you remember doing?

steps.player: I can't quite remember how I managed to save that pirate...

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: The pirate? Yes, you used fishcakes didn't you?

steps.player: I did? Er... I mean I did.
Out of interest, could you just help me quickly with that?
I have all the ingredients for fishcakes!

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Great! Just like before! I've been reading the recipe and I know how to make the fishcakes now.

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: It's pretty simple actually. All you have to do is use the ingredients on each other and then cook the fishcakes on a range.

steps.player: That's it?

steps.speaker: Cook
steps.text: Yes. I thought that there was a page missing from the cookbook because it seemed so easy, but it turns out it really IS that easy!

finishing-up-combining-the-ingredients.text: You mix all the ingredients together to make an uncooked fishcake.

finishing-up-cooking-a-fishcake.text: You manage to cook a fishcake.

finishing-up-inspecting-pirate-pete-whil.speaker: Aris
finishing-up-inspecting-pirate-pete-whil.text: Stop messing about and use the fishcakes on him!

finishing-up-using-the-fishcake-on-pirat.speaker: Aris
finishing-up-using-the-fishcake-on-pirat.text: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have [number] council members left to protect!

sdRxJ4.speaker: Murphy
sdRxJ4.text: Ok, well I'll be here if you change your mind.
